claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Yamaha-branded black electronic keyboard, but do not confirm suitability for children or overall quality.
Photos show the keyboard and controls, but no power-on test or functioning audio/video.
No photo shows the power adapter/cord or its inclusion.
No documentation or label/serial-year proof shown in the photos.
No audio test or key-by-key demonstration is shown.

risks.risk: Exact model is unknown; Yamaha keyboards vary widely in value and features (number of keys, speakers, touch sensitivity, connectivity).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back panel or underside) and the full control panel text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown Yamaha used keyboard with worst-case feature set and no confirmed model-specific value.

risks.risk: No proof it powers on and works (sound output, speaker health, MIDI/USB, and button/slider functionality).
risks.proof: Short video: power on + playing across the full key range + pressing several buttons/sliders + showing volume/speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty until a working demonstration is provided.

risks.risk: Potential keybed issues (dead keys, sticking keys, uneven action) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video showing a key-by-key or at least full-range test (e.g., play a scale from lowest to highest and hold notes to confirm no dead/stuck keys).
risks.if_unproven: Price at a worst-case assumption of possible minor key issues.

risks.risk: Crackle/noise from speakers or outputs may not be visible.
risks.proof: Audio clip/video: play sustained notes at low and high volume to check for crackling/distortion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing speaker/audio service if crackle is later found.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables, stand) can materially reduce value.
risks.proof: Photo of the included items laid out (adapter/cord, sustain pedal, any cables/stand) and a close-up of adapter label/plug type.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming adapter/pedal may be missing.

risks.risk: Physical condition (scratches, dents, missing knobs/buttons, repairs) not fully verifiable from the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of corners, underside, and the entire control panel showing every knob/button/slider; plus any visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average used condition with possible cosmetic wear.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the model number/name label (back/underside) so the exact Yamaha model can be identified.
Send a short video showing the keyboard powering on and producing sound through its speakers.
Show a full key-range test (lowest to highest) to confirm no dead/stuck keys.
Show button/slider functionality (press several labeled buttons and move sliders) with the resulting sound/changes.
Provide photos of the power adapter/cord and confirm it matches the keyboard’s input.
Confirm whether a sustain pedal is included; send a photo of the pedal if available.
Send close-up photos of the entire control panel and any visible damage (knobs/buttons/ports) and the underside.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the key value drivers (exact model, working status, and included adapter/accessories) are not verifiable from the photos. Without a power-on/working proof and model identification, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
